name: patient_has_finding_of_severe_aortic_valve_stenosis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has severe aortic valve stenosis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of severe aortic valve stenosis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of severe aortic valve stenosis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has severe aortic valve stenosis.

name: patient_has_finding_of_symptomatic_aortic_valve_stenosis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has symptomatic aortic valve stenosis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has symptomatic aortic valve stenosis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have symptomatic aortic valve stenosis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has symptomatic aortic valve stenosis.

name: patient_has_finding_of_finding_of_increased_risk_level_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of increased risk level (high risk).
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently considered to have an increased risk level (high risk).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not considered to have an increased risk level (high risk).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently at high risk.

name: patient_is_undergoing_transcatheter_aortic_valve_implantation_now@@deemed_amenable_by_multidisciplinary_team
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation and is deemed amenable for the procedure by a multidisciplinary team.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation and is deemed amenable for the procedure by a multidisciplinary team.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation but is not deemed amenable by a multidisciplinary team.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is deemed amenable for transcatheter aortic valve implantation by a multidisciplinary team.

name: annulus_size_value_recorded_now_in_millimeters
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's annulus size measured in millimeters at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's annulus size is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined at the current time.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's annulus size in millimeters as measured currently.

name: patient_has_finding_of_left_ventricular_thrombus_now

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a left ventricular thrombus.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a left ventricular thrombus.

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of endocarditis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of endocarditis.

name: patient_has_finding_of_endocarditis_now@@active
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current endocarditis is active.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has endocarditis and the endocarditis is active.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has endocarditis but it is not active.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current endocarditis is active.
